record_scope_reconstruction: All four episodes concern the same two road posts, Medininkai and Šalčininkai, with episode-specific exceptions. Official post map supports identical facility references for October22, October24–25, October26–30 and October30–November20 phases.

source_checks.finding: Transport ministry announces October30 formal closure/restriction with Medininkai exceptions and planned November30 horizon.
Government November19 confirms reopening November20 midnight, earlier than planned; only motor vehicles permitted.
VSAT October24 notice closes both21:30 and retrospectively identifies October22 restriction02:30–09:00.
VSAT restores both at noonOctober25 after October24 closure; short episode kept distinct.
October27 ministry account dates preceding Salcininkai closure/Medininkai restricted exceptions to SundayOctober26 evening.
Official directorate homepage links the independently downloaded interactive checkpoint map.
Inspected raw map markers pair named road/rail checkpoints with explicit LatLng values. Road Kybartai and railway Kybartai have different coordinates; mode identity retained.
Official administered-post roster confirms names and road-post addresses; coordinates come from linked map, not inferred address centroids.
